comments.why: Shows Trump's real personality beyond stage persona
comments.text: Watch the Joe Rogan interview with Trump to see what he's really like: [VIDEO] What we normally see is a stage persona. He also speaks differently when dealing with hostiles vs people acting like he's a human being. Rogan's style brings out people's real personalities better.

comments.story: Trump wins presidency for second time
comments.text: This interview between Elon Musk and Joe Rogan explains — though I’m not sure the timestamp. Joe Rogan found it convincing enough to endorse Trump afterwards. [LINK] You could also watch the episode interviewing Trump. [VIDEO] Or his VP, Vance. [LINK] Presumably the majority are people who agree with the message conveyed during such interviews.
